summary: Known recorded limonene allergy and the demo mist's confirmed limonene row.

findings.explanation: Proposed. The recorded allergy list names limonene, and mist_fragranced has a confirmed limonene row. EU Annex III entry 88 requires limonene to be named on the label above a concentration threshold so a sensitised person can see it. A name on a label is not itself an allergy.
findings.reason: Proposed. The match is exact confirmed ID equality. Class fragrance-allergen is not the match key.
limitations: Proposed rules only. This is not a team-approved safety assessment. Severity, when present, is display priority and not a clinical grade.
